audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side reads Pyke,Pyke,Pyke,Pyke,Skill,Skill,Skill on every row, contradicting content win[0..6] = Hwei,Hwei,Skill,Skill,Pyke,Pyke,Hwei, which matches the packet levelChart exactly.
audit.why: win[] already agrees with the packet's real levelChart, so full's side/why/rating are the stale layer and must be brought into line rather than the reverse.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all 7 phases[].side, matching .why, and adjusted .rating to agree with win[] and the packet.

audit.why: Spikes correctly key level-2 waypush poke, level-6 R execute/reset, first-item roam gold snowball, and late-game layered CC outscaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither missingInteractions item (P bypasses stacking resistances; Q Bone Skewer is an interruptible channel) is stated anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns has no real number.
audit.why: Pyke's Q (Bone Skewer) is a channel any hard CC cancels outright; his P converts missing Max HP into bonus AD, so armor stacking alone doesn't answer him.
audit.corrected: Folded both into dosFull[1] and dontsFull[2] (fixing their copy-paste bleed at the same time) and added real Q/R cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: QQ the pair from artillery range — bot's formations eat the lava line beautifully.
edits.after: You start with longer-range Q bolts and W zone that outpoke Pyke's melee Q charge at level 1.

edits.before: Two-paint marks begin: the detonation chunks duos that trade casually.
edits.after: At 2 your waypush burst plus W chunks Pyke before he can regen out of vision.

edits.before: Full palette: EE fear or EQ root into QQ — the support slot's longest pick kit.
edits.after: By 3 it evens out as Pyke gains hook range and roam pressure to match your poke.

edits.before: Mark-detonate the margins and bank Manaflow — the chip war is a gallery show.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay skill-dependent — trades hinge on dodging his Q charge or eating it.

edits.before: Spiraling Despair online — the river fights start at your brush-length.
edits.after: Pyke's R execute-reset turns him into the kill threat, flipping tempo his way.

edits.before: First item: the rotations chunk and the CC paints decide every gank.
edits.after: First item: Pyke's reset gold snowballs him and dictates the map.

edits.before: Late support Hwei opens fights: R the carry, fear the choke, and root whatever the slow catches.
edits.after: By 2+ items your layered CC and EE disengage outscale his single-pick all-in, so you retake the edge.

edits.before: QQ the pair, any second paint for the mark, detonate — gallery math their duo can't price.
edits.after: Pyke's Bone Skewer (Q) channels — your Q or E hard CC cancels it outright before it connects.

edits.before: Painting predictably until the hook learns your rhythm — vary the palette or donate the artist.
edits.after: Pyke's passive (P) converts missing Max HP into bonus AD — stacking armor alone won't shut him down.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E fear paint banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke's Q (Bone Skewer) is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s CD — the hook starts the chain, his R cleans what it catches. - Keep E fear banked for their best play. - The R (100/85/70s CD) is a fight decision, not a habit.
